newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's 7-yr govt bond price rises to 103.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's 7-yr govt bond price rises to 103.90 pct.

text.p: The average price on the latest issue of Hungary's seven-year government bonds rose to 103.90 percent on Thursday from 103.42 percent set at an auction one month ago, the Government Debt Management Agency said on Thursday.

Note: The bond, issued on October 17, 1996, bears a floating interest rate of year-on-year consumer price inflation plus three percent, and is calculated twice yearly, on March 20 and September 20. Interest is paid annually on September 24.
